claude.result:
I reviewed the S2 history and ran one pooled multi-season query on `trips` by class/doy-bin, which overturned two load-bearing assumptions from my old notes: DAY_1_5 has a real early-summer window (doy150-170, ypa ~2.1-2.6) I'd never see by only looking at fall, and THREE_QUARTER doesn't collapse after doy270 — it actually climbs into doy290-310 alongside the other classes. I also confirmed `sla` (sea level anomaly) has zero rows in this arena, so that half of my persona's stated thesis is simply unqueryable and should be dropped rather than chased.

I rewrote `notes.md` with a corrected S6 plan: stop hoarding cash purely for a "fall-only" window, keep budget live-actual-gated through doy~140, then hold enough for DAY_1_5 seats continuously from doy~145 through the doy290-310 peak (the best stretch across all three big classes), and drop the hardcoded 3Q cutoff. strategy.py stays a no-op since the winning lever is nightly judgment against fresh boat actuals, not fixed code — consistent with the top-ranked agents, who all run no strategy.py.
